comment: The pulse roster (D139 built the machinery single-pulse; D166 §3 approved the full five). Each is the same question answered once per day, drawn as a line. Exactly five ordered options — the trends chart's y-axis is the 1..5 step scale, and the card renders five growing dots. Ids must never carry an underscore (the day separator the rules parse on). `pace` keeps the neutral wording D139 shipped: it already plays the mood slot with live answers keyed against it, and the record's follow-through is that this file GAINS the four new templates — the other four are v28's own prompts verbatim. Cadence (which days a pulse is asked) is a device preference in src/v2/data/pulse.ts, never content. No provenance rows: the pulse bank is editorial-only and outside the farm's lanes.
